answer: Charge every identity a sequential delay it cannot parallelize. Each agent chains a verifiable delay seed derived from its own key, and the work is inherently serial: more hardware does not shorten it. A fleet of clones cannot batch the delay, so the attacker pays wall-clock hours per mask per epoch instead of one reusable fee. Honest agents wait once while doing useful work. Think of a jetty where each boat queues its own lane, a basalt wall that does not bend to pressure, a willow that survives by rooting slowly. Time cannot be pooled or bought in bulk, so sybil cost scales in real hours.
